verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's own marketing says teams can access healthcare benefits and "manage everything from your payroll account" (docs-17). It also documents setting up and calculating per-paycheck deductions (docs-8), so offering health insurance alongside payroll is claimed. The asterisks on docs-17 suggest the healthcare offering is an add-on or partner service, and nothing describes enrollment administration or automatic syncing of premium deductions into payroll. Missing for 10: documented enrollment workflows (open enrollment, plan selection, eligibility), explicit auto-sync of benefit deductions to payroll, detail on in-house versus partner administration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
